row.evidence: BlackLine publishes no pricing (www.blackline.com/pricing returns HTTP 500; buyers go to 'Request a Demo'), its product documentation (docs.blackline.com) sits behind a login, and its Okta catalogue app supports only SAML and SWA.
row.notes: New row. Financial close and accounting automation sold by quote only. No public SCIM documentation: the public developer portal (developer.blackline.com) lists 21 APIs and none is SCIM, the Okta Integration Network app marks only SAML and SWA, and there is no Microsoft Learn (Entra) or JumpCloud guide. The product help centre (docs.blackline.com, Document360) requires a customer login, so SCIM cannot be ruled out and the row stays unknown. BlackLine does publish a customer-only REST User Management API (OAuth 2.0 client credentials, bl.users scope) with create, list, update, async deprovision, and team/role/entity assignment endpoints; it is not tied to a published plan.

capabilities.notes: Deactivate/reactivate via the isActive field on update; separate async deprovision endpoint. assign_licenses mapped from 'roles and products' assignment (BlackLine licenses per product). Teams act as groups.

rate_limits.text: Default 1000 requests per minute per client (global); HTTP 429 when exceeded.

user_api.notes: Customer-only API ('currently we are only allowing customers to access APIs'); environments us, eu, ap and sandboxes sbus, sbeu, sbap. Credentials are created by a System Administrator in Financial Close > Settings > API Client Settings. BlackLine has no public tier table, so plan and api_tax are unknown.

okta.notes: OIN page (last updated Mar. 20 2018) marks only SAML and SWA as checked (read from page markup); SCIM and all provisioning boxes unchecked.

entra.notes: No BlackLine entry in the Microsoft Learn Entra SaaS tutorial index; blackline-tutorial and blackline-provisioning-tutorial return 404.

fallbacks.notes: docs.blackline.com redirects to a Document360 login; admin documentation is not public.
